title: SERP.fyi FAQ Engine: 40 Official SERP.fyi FAQs with a Question-Matching Engine
description: SERP.fyi FAQ Engine answers questions about SERP.fyi, a search intelligence platform for real-time rank tracking, AI visibility audits, entity recognition, local SEO, SERP features and reporting. It matches a plain-English question against 40 official FAQs and returns the best answer with a 0 to 100 confidence score. Includes TypeScript (NPM) and Python (PyPI) implementations and an FAQ dataset (CSV). Built by SERP.fyi.
